svg.title: ScienceIDE — environments, task repair, verification and learning
svg.desc: IDE showcase using published repository content. The CFC task displays its instruction and reference repair. Archived nop and oracle evaluations grade cfc-offline and cfc-online. SFT is a workflow concept whose pipeline is not in this preview. RL shows the published Qwen3.5-4B reward summaries from async GRPO on PSRL.
svg.text: Find and fix exactly one localized source defect in MITgcm
scope is the CFC atmospheric interpolation and gas-exchange
subsystem. The root cause and its exact source location are yours
to find. Restore the pinned incumbent behavior;
